selected_passages.text:
- Sam Bankman-Fried is currently on trial for seven counts of fraud and conspiracy related to FTX.
- FTX collapsed in November 2022 after exposing a balance sheet showing impossible FTT token holdings.
- Bankman-Fried pleaded not guilty to all charges and faces up to 115 years in prison if convicted.
- Former executives Gary Wang and Caroline Ellison pleaded guilty and will serve as key witnesses.
- The trial is represented by Mark Cohen of Cohen & Gresser, who previously defended Ghislaine Maxwell.

selected_passages.text:
- Sam Bankman-Fried was the former CEO of FTX.
- The trial took place on the second day.
- Thane Rehn was the prosecutor for the government.
- Mark Cohen was one of Bankman-Fried's lawyers.
- Damian Williams is the U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York.
- Caroline Ellison was the CEO of Alameda Research.
- Alameda Research is a crypto hedge fund owned by Bankman-Fried.
- Jane Street is a high-frequency trading firm where Bankman-Fried started.
- Matt Huang is a former partner at Sequoia Capital.
- Marc-Antoine Julliard is a Paris-born cocoa trader living in London.
- Julliard invested in Bitcoin and Dogecoin on FTX.
- Julliard tried to withdraw almost $100,000 on November 8.
- Adam Yedidia is a graduate of MIT.
- Yedidia was a close friend of Bankman-Fried in college.
- Yedidia worked as a trader at Alameda and a developer at FTX.
- Yedidia has legal immunity during his testimony.
- Bankman-Fried spent about seven weeks in a Brooklyn prison.
- The prosecution's story lasted roughly 30 minutes.
- Tom Brady and Larry David are celebrities mentioned in the prosecution's account.
- Fortune magazine is cited as having written about Bankman-Fried as a 'crypto boy' genius.
